Friend must complete a direct deposit OR $250+ in debit-card purchases within 60 days of account opening (ATM withdrawals do not count)
Reward is a $50 Mastercard Reward Card for each party, not cash into the account

Membership/account eligibility applies (First Bank serves North and South Carolina)

Sign up on the referral page to start earning referral rewards
Share your referral link with friends
Friend registers and opens a new personal checking account at First Bank
Friend makes a direct deposit or $250+ in debit-card purchases (excluding ATM withdrawals) within 60 days
You both receive a $50 Mastercard Reward Card
